competitionScope: Odds-listed FBS games in ncaaf-phase-e-closing-lines.json (matchable americanfootball_ncaaf names). FCS/unlisted excluded.

selectionRules.prices: Prefer Odds historical ~24h pre-kickoff cache (two-sided). Fixture fallback: home ML only + −home spread @ −110 (R1/R2 — no vig-free away ML invent).
selectionRules.candidates: home ML + home/away spread always; away ML only when odds-early-cache
selectionRules.sideChoice: Among qualifiers, prefer sim-favored side when |homeWinP-awayWinP|>=0.03; rank by edgePct then simHit. NOT blanket home.
selectionRules.note: Offline eval applies Coach SIMULATION numeric gates + locked R1–R4 remediations (docs/coach/ncaaf-e2b-clv-acceptance-criteria.md). Full Final-AI rubric grades are not reconstructed; product NCAAF P0 remains armed.

coachPickClv.unit: probability_points_0_to_1 for ML CLV; spread points for spreadClv

untouchedPeriodMarketBaseline.note: No Coach selections on this period — close-ML Brier only.

verdicts.E2b_coachPickClvNote: Criteria locked before scoring; C2 requires meanClv≥0 (no negative floor). R1–R4 applied.
